description: This line plot illustrates the Loss Ratio (%) across different TFLOPs values for five model configurations: Vanilla, SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=128), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T). The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and utilizes a custom discrete scale with values plotted at equal spatial intervals, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8; specific tick labels are provided at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, followed by increments of 1e8 up to 9e8. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" and features a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with grid lines and numerical tick marks spaced at intervals of 1. The Vanilla configuration is represented by a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers and remains entirely steady at a value of 100 across the entire x-axis from 1e7 to 9e8. The SepLLM (n=64) configuration is shown as a solid orange line with plus markers; it begins at approximately 98.3 at 1e7, rises to a peak of roughly 100.4 at 4e8, and then settles to roughly 100.0 at 9e8. The SepLLM (n=128) configuration, depicted by a solid dark blue line with 'x' markers, starts at roughly 97.0 at 1e7, climbs to 99.8 at 2e8, and experiences minor fluctuations before ending at approximately 99.8 at 9e8. The SepLLM (n=64, H) configuration is a solid green line with diamond markers that starts at roughly 97.5 at 1e7, increases to 100.0 at 2e8, reaches a localized peak of approximately 100.2 at 6e8, and concludes at about 99.9 at 9e8. Finally, the SepLLM (n=64, H/T) configuration is plotted as a solid red line with circle markers; it starts at the lowest plotted value of 94.0 at 1e7, demonstrates a steep upward trend to a peak of approximately 99.1 at 4e8, declines to 98.4 at 5e8, and finishes at roughly 98.7 at 9e8.
